entry.title: Basis conjecture for the box-kernel relations
entry.statement: For positive integers $z,d$ with $z\leq d$, let $\mathcal{K}_{z,d}$ and $\operatorname{Box}_{z,d}$ be as defined in the source. **Basis conjecture.** If $z\leq d$, then $\mathcal{K}_{z,d}$ is a basis of $\operatorname{ker}\operatorname{Box}_{z,d}$. This refines the box-kernel conjecture by asserting linear independence as well as spanning; the paper gives no proof in general.

entry.title: Ferroni–Schröter's real-rootedness conjecture for Chow polynomials
entry.literal_statement: Let $\mathrm{M}$ be a matroid, and let its Chow polynomial be the polynomial invariant associated with its lattice of flats. **Ferroni–Schröter's conjecture.** The Chow polynomial of $\mathrm{M}$ has only nonpositive real roots. This is a central real-rootedness question for matroid invariants; the source presents it as a motivating conjecture, without stating a resolution.

entry.ordinary_attempt_and_gap_or_explicit_exc: Berczi, Coron, Eur, Li publicly refute this exact assertion on 12 October 2026. Theorem C gives simple 3-connected rank-seven matroids Tr^7(M_q directsum M_q directsum U_1,1) whose ordinary Chow polynomial is not real-rooted for odd prime powers q>=47. Choose prime47. This directly negates all-matroid real-rootedness, with no inference from failures of a stronger property. Theorem B plus Theorem A and Corollary D supplies a separate non-log-concavity amplification route; nonnegative real-rooted polynomials are log-concave by Newton. Proof bodies describe flag counts and discriminant thresholds; this lane did not rerun those computations or audit every construction lemma.

entry.title: Homotopy conjecture for total cut complexes of powers of cycles
entry.statement:
Let $C_n^p$ denote the $p$th power of the cycle graph $C_n$, and let $\Delta_k^t(C_n^p)$ be its $k$-total cut complex.

**The total cut complex conjecture.** For $p\ge 3$ and $n\ge (2k-1)p+1$,

$$
\Delta_k^t(C_n^p)\simeq \mathbb{S}^{n-2k}.
$$

This conjecture generalizes the preceding computational predictions from fixed values of $k$ to arbitrary $k$ in the stated range. The source provides computational evidence but no resolution.
entry.review_depth: Definition of total cut complex, Theorems 1.2–1.3 context, Tables 1–3, Conjectures 5.1–5.2
entry.mathematical_attempt: Facets are complements of independent k-sets. Computed Alexander-dual complex consisting of subsets with independence number <k. Euler and mod2 homology can falsify but cannot prove homotopy sphere or exclude odd torsion.
entry.exact_search_coverage: outputs/cut-euler.json: 61 admissible triples with p3..7,n<=24,k2..4. outputs/cut-homology.json: 13 k3 cases p3,n16..24; p4,n21..24. outputs/cut-sparse.json: k3,(n,p)=(34,3),(40,3),(48,3),(34,4),(40,4), beyond source largest reported k3 n33. All reduced mod2 dual homology exactly rank1 in degree3; no obstruction.
entry.remaining_gap: Need sphere homotopy, not merely Euler/homology; possible discrete Morse collapse or integral torsion search. No full proof.

entry.title: Prime Coxeter number conjecture for dominant numbers of dual fundamental series
entry.literal_statement:
Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be the simple Lie algebra considered in the topological ODE construction, with Coxeter number $h$, rank $n$, and dual fundamental series $\phi_{a;a}$ for $a\in\{1,\dots,n\}$. For each $a$, let $r_a$ be the smallest order of a scalar linear ODE with polynomial coefficients in $x$ satisfied by $\phi_{a;a}$; this ODE is called its dominant equation, and $r_a$ its dominant number. The point $x=0$ is a regular singularity of the dominant equation. **Prime Coxeter number conjecture.** If $h$ is prime, then

$$
r_1=\dots=r_n=h-1.
$$

The assertion predicts a uniform maximal value for the dominant numbers when the Coxeter number is prime. The supplied text does not indicate whether this claim has been proved or remains open.
entry.mathematics: Prime Coxeter numbers restrict possible Lie types strongly, but proving exact minimal differential order needs irreducibility of all dominant equations. No all-prime irreducibility argument; computed small types would be parameter instances.
